# IIMADOUU — Imad Eddine Aris

> IIMADOUU is the studio name of Imad Eddine Aris, a freelance web designer and
> full stack developer based in Chebli, Blida, Algeria. He designs and builds
> websites, backends and APIs, Flutter mobile apps, Windows desktop software and
> online stores for businesses in Algeria and abroad. Languages: Arabic, French,
> English. Prices are published in Algerian Dinar (DZD) and start at 40,000 DZD.

## Services
- [Web design](https://iimadouu.github.io/web-design.html): website design, UI/UX, redesigns, Arabic and French layouts. From 40,000 DZD.
- [Website and frontend development](https://iimadouu.github.io/web-development.html): hand-built HTML, CSS and JavaScript sites, landing pages, business sites, dashboards. From 40,000 DZD.
- [Backend and API development](https://iimadouu.github.io/backend-development.html): REST APIs with Python/Flask and Node/Express, database design, authentication, roles, payments, real-time sync. From 70,000 DZD.
- [Mobile app development](https://iimadouu.github.io/mobile-app-development.html): Flutter apps for Android and iOS, Firebase, notifications, offline support, store release. From 35,000 DZD.
- [Windows software development](https://iimadouu.github.io/software-development.html): desktop applications including document archiving with OCR, stock management, HR and payroll, POS and ERP. From 45,000 DZD.
- [E-commerce and marketplace development](https://iimadouu.github.io/ecommerce-development.html): online stores and multi-vendor marketplaces, cash-on-delivery checkout, vendor dashboards. From 225,000 DZD.

## Pricing
- Full published rate card in English, French and Arabic: https://iimadouu.github.io/pricing.html
- Range: 40,000 DZD (static landing page) to 1,800,000 DZD (advanced marketplace).
- Currency: Algerian Dinar (DZD). Quotes are fixed per project after a short scope call.
